name: Smoodh toffee caramel
ingredients_raw: MILK SOLIDS, SUGAR, DEXTROSE, FOOD COLOUR (INS 150c) (0.92%), MALT EXTRACT, EMULSIFIERS AND STABILIZERS [INS 460(1), INS 471, INS 466, INS 407, INS 340, INS 452], NATURAL AND NATURE IDENTICAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCES (CARAMEL, COCOA, TOFFEE), ARTIFICIAL FLAVOURING SUBSTANCE (VANILLA) AND IODISED SALT. (EQUIVALENT TO 90% M/M DOUBLE TONED MILK) (INS-INTERNATIONAL NUMBERING SYSTEM) ALLERGEN INFORMATION: CONTAINS MILK, BARLEY, WHEAT AND MILLET
